notes.title: Version 2 Released
notes.notes: Version 2 has been released which includes the new Endless Heck mode. Fight over an endless stream of enemies while trying to get to the exit.

notes.title: Version 2 - Endless Heck Mode!
notes.notes: Endless Heck Mode has been added. Get to the exit while avoiding an endless stream of enemies. Don't get hit though as you will start from the beginning.

notes.title: Update 1.1.5 - New Game Mode Added!
notes.notes: A new Game Mode has been added. Race Mode is a battle to get to the exit as fast as you can against the AI.

notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.notes: Bug with stats on main menu fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3
notes.notes: Fix for audio not playing properly

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1.1 includes the following changes...

[list]
[*]Slingshot Mode - use the mouse to aim your way to the exit. You drag the mouse and release to aim and fire.
[*]Pause menu bug fixed
[/list]

[previewyoutube=YE-n1O3ZwL4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Endless Heck Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.0 of Endless Heck now includes a new game mode called 'Countdown'. The aim of the Countdown mode is to get to the exit before the 10 second timer hits 0.

This update also changes the main menu UI and makes it easier to navigate.

Good luck, don't hit the walls!
